D: The turtles travel back in time to feudal Japan to rescue April.
P: Serve the hotpot when the turtles follow Mitsu to her village.
S: Rice balls brushed with miso and soy, grilled crisp over the coals. Four guards went to New York, four turtles came back in their armour.

Cook 2 cups short grain rice and cool until you can handle it. With wet salted hands, press into 8 firm triangles. Mix 2 tbsp white miso with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar. Grill the onigiri in a lightly oiled pan or on a barbecue for 4 minutes a side until crisp, brushing with the miso glaze in the last minute. Wrap the base of each in a strip of nori.
Chicken thigh and spring onion skewers grilled over coals, basted with soy and mirin tare. Uh, o-hi-o, wasabi.

Simmer 80ml soy sauce, 80ml mirin and 2 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy. Cut 600g chicken thighs into 3cm pieces and 1 bunch spring onions into 3cm lengths, and thread onto 12 soaked skewers. Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning and basting with the tare in the last 3 minutes.
Eggplant halves grilled soft and glazed with sweet miso and sesame. Grilled while Donatello builds a second sceptre. It doesn't go well.

Halve 2 eggplants lengthways, score the flesh and brush with 2 tbsp vegetable oil. Grill cut side down for 8 minutes, turn and cook 8 minutes more until soft. Mix 3 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp water, spread over the cut sides and grill until bubbling. Scatter with toasted sesame seeds.
M: Chicken, daikon, shiitake and cabbage simmered in kombu dashi with soy, a pot in the middle of the table. Sixty hours to get home, time for one hotpot.

Soak a 10cm piece of kombu in 1.5L water for 30 minutes, then bring to a simmer and lift it out. Add 3 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp mirin. Add half a daikon cut into thick half moons and simmer 10 minutes. Add 600g chicken thigh in chunks and simmer 10 minutes. Add 150g fresh shiitake, a quarter of a Chinese cabbage in wedges and 300g firm tofu in cubes and cook 5 minutes more. Finish with sliced spring onions and serve the pot at the table with rice.
Buckwheat noodles in hot soy dashi with spring onion and a soft egg. Kenshin got sent the other way, to New York.

Bring 1.2L dashi to a simmer with 4 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp mirin. Soft boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes and peel. Cook 360g dried soba for 4 minutes, rinse and divide between 4 bowls. Pour the hot broth over, add a halved egg to each and scatter sliced spring onions.
W: Kinako dango with brown sugar syrup
Soft rice flour dumplings rolled in roasted soybean flour, dark brown sugar syrup poured over. For Splinter's Elvis at the end.

Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 80ml water for 5 minutes until syrupy and cool. Mix 200g glutinous rice flour with about 180ml water to a soft dough like an earlobe. Roll into 24 balls, press a dimple in each and drop into boiling water. Cook until they float, then 1 minute more, and lift into iced water. Drain, roll in 40g kinako mixed with 1 tbsp caster sugar, thread 3 to a skewer and pour the syrup over.
K: Roasted barley steeped and chilled, nutty and clean. I told you these disguises weren't gonna work.

Toast 60g pearl barley in a dry pan until dark golden, 8 minutes. Simmer in 1.5L water for 10 minutes, cool, strain and chill. Serve over ice. Or steep 4 roasted barley tea bags in 1.5L cold water for 2 hours.
